title: Phase 3.2 — NETPILOT-CCNA-APP: Audit and verify CCNA Automation GitHub App
spec:
PHASE 3.2: NETPILOT-CCNA-APP

Complete the CCNA Automation GitHub App — audit current state and identify what needs building.

LOCATION: tools/netpilot/ccna_automation_github_app/

This is an AUDIT-FIRST task — understand what exists before making changes.

---

TASK 1: BACKEND AUDIT (FastAPI)
- Check directory structure: `backend/app/`
- Review `backend/requirements.txt` — list dependencies and versions
- Check if `backend/app/main.py` exists and what it does
- Try to run: `cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && python -m app.main`
  - If it fails, document the error (don't fix yet)
  - If it succeeds, check what endpoints are available
- Check for tests: `pytest tests/` or `python -m pytest`
  - Report test count and pass/fail status
- Document API endpoints (if any exist)
- Check for OpenAPI/Swagger docs at /docs or /redoc

---

TASK 2: FRONTEND AUDIT (React)
- Check directory structure: `frontend/src/`
- Review `frontend/package.json` — list dependencies
- Try to run: `cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev`
  - If it fails, document the error (don't fix yet)
  - If it succeeds, check what port it runs on
- List all components in `frontend/src/components/`
- Check which views/pages exist
- Document which components render vs throw errors
- Check for tests: `npm test` (report status)

---

TASK 3: DATA MODEL AUDIT
- Check for `schema.sql` or database migration files
- Check for `seed.json` or seed data
- Check for `domain_map.yaml` — verify it exists and is well-formed
- Document the data model:
  - What tables/collections exist
  - What entities are defined (labs, topics, questions, etc.)
  - How complete is the domain map

---

TASK 4: DOCUMENTATION AUDIT
- Check for README.md at repo root
- Check for docs/ directory
- Document what's explained vs missing
- Check for architecture diagrams or design docs

---

TASK 5: SECURITY CHECK
- grep for hardcoded credentials in source
- Verify .env.example exists with placeholders
- Check .gitignore coverage
- Report any findings

---

TASK 6: INTEGRATION CHECK
- Check if there's GitHub App integration code
- Check for webhook handlers
- Check for GitHub API client usage
- Document what's implemented vs placeholder

---

REPORT FORMAT:
For each task area, provide:
- Status: FUNCTIONAL / PLACEHOLDER / BROKEN / MISSING
- What exists
- What's missing or broken
- Recommended next sprint (prioritized list of what to build)

CONSTRAINTS:
- Read-only audit — do NOT fix errors or install dependencies globally
- OK to run `npm install` and `pip install` in local project directories
- Document all findings before recommending changes
- If something is broken, explain WHY (missing deps, config, etc.)

VERIFICATION:
- List all key files found
- Provide directory tree of the project structure
- Report on build/run status for backend and frontend
